Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the July 1, 2022 content date, the multiple-choice format and its four roughly equal topic areas, the vision standard and the one-day retake wait from physical pages 3, 35 and 36; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- TN-BELT-A-EXAM — question count, passing score and time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-BELT-A-FRESH — content dated July 1, 2022; current edition and liveness unconfirmed (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-BELT-D-AGE — back-seat belt age: under seventeen versus eighteen or older (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- TN-BELT-D-UNATTENDED — unattended-child penalty: fine-only Class B misdemeanor versus Class A misdemeanor to Class A felony (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- TN-BELT-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- TN-BELT-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: belt and child restraint fines, misdemeanor classes and the quoted crash statistics (for example sec06-F10, sec06-F37, sec06-R07, sec06-R09) can change and must be refreshed from official Tennessee sources.
